stem.text: Graphs can be drawn to show the percentage of ammonia at equilibrium when nitrogen and hydrogen are mixed at different temperatures and pressures.
Which diagram correctly represents these two graphs?

A.alt: Graph of % NH3 at equilibrium against pressure / 10^3 kPa: both curves fall from 40 at 0 kPa; dashed 400 °C curve lies above solid 500 °C curve.

B.alt: Graph of % NH3 at equilibrium against pressure / 10^3 kPa: both curves fall from 40 at 0; solid 500 °C curve lies above dashed 400 °C curve.

C.alt: Graph of % NH3 at equilibrium against pressure / 10^3 kPa: both curves rise from 0; solid 500 °C curve lies above dashed 400 °C curve.

D.alt: Graph of % NH3 at equilibrium against pressure / 10^3 kPa: both curves rise from 0; dashed 400 °C curve lies above solid 500 °C curve.
